title: Research with Claude

body.text: Use Claude as a research assistant:
summarize long documents, compare multiple sources, and ask follow-up questions
— upload reports, articles, or market data, then probe exactly the points you need right away.

example: "From these 3 market reports, summarize the trends all of them agree on, and the points where they conflict, with each side's reasoning"

title: Always verify the source

body.text: A principle for researchers using AI:
have the AI cite which part of the document each conclusion comes from
— and for key facts you'll base a decision on, open the source document and verify it yourself; don't rely on the summary alone.

example: "For every conclusion, state which document and which page it came from, so I can check it back"

question: How does Claude help with research?

options.text: Summarizes long documents and compares multiple sources
Guesses the research results for you

question: Why ask the AI to cite the source of each conclusion?

options.text: So you can check it back against the real data

question: For a key fact you'll base an important decision on, what should you do?

options.text: Open the source document and verify it yourself
Ask the AI 3 more times and that's enough

question: When using Claude for research, what should you always do?

options.text: Verify the source before believing it

question: Why must you verify the source?

options.text: The AI may give inaccurate info or fabricate a source
